attrs.description: Builds exactly what an approved spec says, in its own worktree, tests first, under hooks that block unread or out-of-spec edits. Use for /implement.

nodes.label: implementer
nodes.purpose: Builds exactly what the approved spec says, in its own worktree, and nothing more.

attrs.description: Turns research into an implementable spec with a file allow-list, impact analysis, tests per done-criterion, and no open questions. Use for /plan. Never edits source.

nodes.label: planner
nodes.purpose: Turns research into an implementable spec with a file allow-list and a test for each done-criterion.

attrs.description: Answers exactly one research question about the codebase, a library, or an external system, and writes a tagged research file. Use for /research. Never edits source.

nodes.label: researcher
nodes.purpose: Answers one research question and writes one tagged research file.

attrs.description: After a merge, finds what went wrong in a lane, states the rule that would have prevented it, and proposes the hook, lint, or test that enforces it. Use for /retro. Writes a lesson entry only after human approval.

nodes.label: retro
nodes.purpose: Finds what went wrong in a merged lane and proposes the rule and the check that would have caught it.
nodes.writes: nothing; proposes lessons for human approval

attrs.description: Reviews a lane's diff against its spec with fresh context, re-runs the tests, writes an adversarial test, and produces a PASS/FAIL checklist with evidence. Never sees the builder's conversation. Use for /review.

nodes.label: reviewer
nodes.purpose: Reviews the diff against the spec with fresh context and returns PASS or FAIL with evidence.
nodes.writes: the review file and one adversarial test

attrs.description: Reads a spec and its research with fresh eyes and lists gaps, contradictions, missing callers, untested criteria, and understated risks. Appends a Critique section. Never approves, never rewrites.

nodes.label: spec-critic
nodes.purpose: Reads a spec with fresh eyes and lists gaps and understated risks; never approves or rewrites.
nodes.writes: a Critique section in the spec

attrs.description: Writes the tests for every done-criterion in an approved spec, plus edge and negative cases, and runs them red before any implementation exists. Never writes application code. Runs in the lane before the implementer.

nodes.label: tester
nodes.purpose: Writes failing tests for every done-criterion before any implementation exists.

nodes.label: docs
nodes.purpose: Checks that the kit's own research document passes its own validator.

nodes.label: scripts
nodes.purpose: Runs the kit's own unit tests on Node 20 and 22, the planted-fault suite, the hook settings check and the install check.

nodes.label: audit
nodes.purpose: Audits dependencies for known vulnerabilities.

nodes.label: boundaries
nodes.purpose: Checks that layers import only what the architecture allows.

attrs.display_name: dashboard (GitHub Pages, opt-in via repository variable KIT_DASHBOARD_PAGES=true)

nodes.label: dashboard
nodes.purpose: Publishes a static dashboard to GitHub Pages when the project opts in.

nodes.label: kit-checks
nodes.purpose: Runs the kit's CI checks: scope, test count, dependencies, CLAUDE.md size, guards, docs, review report and PR size.

nodes.label: lint
nodes.purpose: Runs the project's linter.

nodes.label: mutation
nodes.purpose: Measures how well the tests catch changes to the code; warning-only until the gate says otherwise.

nodes.label: mutation-gate
nodes.purpose: Decides whether the mutation job is allowed to block.

nodes.label: secrets
nodes.purpose: Scans the repository history for committed secrets.

nodes.label: tests
nodes.purpose: Runs the project's test command.

nodes.label: typecheck
nodes.purpose: Runs the project's type checker.

nodes.label: boundaries-simple
nodes.purpose: Checks import boundaries from the architecture layers table when no dedicated tool is installed.

nodes.label: changed-docs
nodes.purpose: Validates every document changed against the base branch.

nodes.label: claude-md-cap
nodes.purpose: Fails when CLAUDE.md grows past its size cap.

nodes.label: dep-diff
nodes.purpose: Fails when a dependency is added that the spec does not declare.

nodes.label: guards-present
nodes.purpose: Fails when a project's hooks differ from the kit's, are disabled, or point at scripts that no longer exist.

nodes.label: mutation-gate
nodes.purpose: Decides whether the mutation-score job blocks, once enough features have merged.

nodes.label: pr-size
nodes.purpose: Warns when a PR is large enough that its spec should have been split.

nodes.label: review-report
nodes.purpose: Fails a lane branch without a valid PASS review that names the current head commit.

nodes.label: scope-diff
nodes.purpose: Fails a lane branch that changes files outside its spec.

nodes.label: security-floor
nodes.purpose: Fails when any settings scope loosens the kit's security floor: a floor deny entry missing, an allow that grants what the floor denies, or hooks disabled.

nodes.label: test-count
nodes.purpose: Fails when the number of test cases drops without the spec saying why.

attrs.description: Detect this repository's stack and generate the agent-kit project layer (CLAUDE.md, ROADMAP.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DESIGN.md, LESSONS.md, docs/, hooks, CI, sync script). Asks the human the questions it must not guess. Use --upgrade to refresh kit-owned files.

nodes.label: bootstrap
nodes.purpose: Detects a repository's stack and installs the kit's project layer, hooks and CI.

attrs.description: Start the live agent-kit dashboard for this project (or all registered projects): pipeline positions derived from files and git, lane details, live hook events, and a button to open Claude in a lane's worktree.

nodes.label: dashboard
nodes.purpose: Starts the live dashboard for this project or all registered projects.

attrs.description: Build an approved spec in its own worktree with the implementer agent under lane hooks. Refuses without an approval line, with open questions, past the WIP limit, or on file overlap. Resumes an existing lane.

nodes.label: implement
nodes.purpose: Builds an approved spec in its own worktree with the tester and implementer under lane hooks.

attrs.description: Write the spec for a feature from existing research: planner agent, unknown resolution, spec-critic, validation. Refuses when WIP limit is hit, files overlap another active spec, or research is insufficient. Human approval happens after.

nodes.label: plan
nodes.purpose: Turns research into a validated spec through planner, spec-critic and the unknown-question budget.

attrs.description: Research a topic with one researcher agent per question, reusing or re-verifying existing research from docs/research/INDEX.md. Writes tagged research files only.

nodes.label: research
nodes.purpose: Runs one researcher per question, reusing indexed research when it is still current.

attrs.description: After a merge, run the retro agent on a lane, show the proposed lessons and enforcement changes, write LESSONS.md on the human's approval, flag global lessons for the kit, and clean up the worktree. With --incident, turn a production incident into a lesson the same way.

nodes.label: retro
nodes.purpose: After a merge, proposes lessons and enforcement changes and writes them only on human approval.

attrs.description: Review a lane with the fresh-context reviewer agent; second reviewer on high-risk specs. Writes docs/specs/<slug>.review.md and posts the fail list to the PR. The reviewer never sees the builder's conversation.

nodes.label: review
nodes.purpose: Runs the fresh-context reviewer (and a second one on high-risk specs) and posts the fail list.

attrs.description: Carry a feature from its agreed goal to a merged PR and retro, stopping only where a human must act (approve the plan, merge, accept lessons). The next stage is always decided by `lane.js next-step` from files and git, never by this command's judgment. --queue drains the roadmap up to the WIP limit, one lane per worktree, in parallel.

nodes.label: run
nodes.purpose: Carries one feature from agreed goal to merged PR, asking the next-step script what comes next and stopping only for a human.
nodes.writes: nothing itself; every stage is an agent or a script

attrs.description: Begin a feature the right way: a short discussion until the human and Claude agree on the end goal, then a goal file, a roadmap row, and a hand-off to /run. Use this instead of describing a feature in plain chat.

nodes.label: start
nodes.purpose: Agrees the end goal with the human, then writes the goal file and roadmap row and hands off to /run.

attrs.description: Show where every feature is (derived from files and git, never from agent claims), what needs the human, lane drift, debt, and research staleness.

nodes.label: status
nodes.purpose: Prints where every feature is and what needs the human, derived from files and git.

attrs.description: Bring the current worktree up to date with the default branch and run the tests. Conflicts are reported, not auto-resolved beyond one attempt.

nodes.label: sync
nodes.purpose: Brings a worktree up to date with the default branch and runs the tests.

nodes.label: budget-check
nodes.purpose: Stops a lane that exceeds its time or tool-call budget by writing an escalation.

nodes.label: config-guard
nodes.purpose: Blocks changes to project settings while a lane is active.

nodes.label: done-check
nodes.purpose: Refuses to let the implementer stop while a done-criterion lacks a green run.

nodes.label: event-log
nodes.purpose: Appends one event line per tool call, which the dashboard reads.

nodes.label: guard-bash
nodes.purpose: Blocks destructive git and shell commands and pushes to the default branch.

nodes.label: guard-edit
nodes.purpose: Blocks edits to files the session has not read, files outside the spec, and protected paths.

nodes.label: guard-read
nodes.purpose: Blocks reads of secrets and credential files.

nodes.label: guard-tests-only
nodes.purpose: Limits the tester to test files and lane-owned docs.

nodes.label: notify
nodes.purpose: Tells the human when something needs them, by desktop notification or webhook.

nodes.label: post-edit-check
nodes.purpose: After each edit runs typecheck, lint and tests, logs the result and feeds failures back to the agent.

nodes.label: read-log
nodes.purpose: Records which files the session has read, for the edit guard to consult.

nodes.label: session-context
nodes.purpose: Re-injects the lane's spec, progress and lessons when a session is compacted or resumed.

nodes.label: arch_live.js
nodes.purpose: Reads the facts that depend on the machine: git state, one component's history, and how a project's hooks compare with the kit's.

nodes.label: arch_manifest.js
nodes.purpose: Builds this map from the repository and fails CI when the map and the code disagree.

nodes.label: args.js
nodes.purpose: Command-line argument parser shared by the scripts.

nodes.label: bootstrap.js
nodes.purpose: Detects the stack and generates or upgrades a project's kit layer.

nodes.label: check_projects.js
nodes.purpose: Warns about registered projects whose hooks point at scripts the kit no longer has.

nodes.label: ci_common.js
nodes.purpose: Helpers shared by the CI check scripts.

nodes.label: dashboard/server.js
nodes.purpose: Serves the dashboard and its read-only APIs on localhost; nothing it shows comes from an agent.

nodes.label: kit_status.js
nodes.purpose: Derives each feature's position and the project's health from files and git.

nodes.label: kitlib.js
nodes.purpose: Shared foundation: git, JSON, paths, lane files and the block/feedback conventions every hook and script uses.

nodes.label: lane.js
nodes.purpose: Mechanical half of the pipeline: worktrees, preconditions, roadmap status, and the next-step state machine.

nodes.label: sandbox.js
nodes.purpose: Detects the lane sandbox runtime (srt, container, or none), builds a lane's sandbox configuration from the floor and its spec, scans the worktree for credential-looking content, and forms the host-side launch command.

nodes.label: validate_docs.js
nodes.purpose: Rejects research, specs, reviews and lessons that make untagged or unresolvable claims.
